meta.title: Battle Beacon | Build Your Deck. Conquer Your Galaxy.
meta.description: Battle Beacon helps Star Wars: Unlimited players find local events, track their competitive journey, and stay connected to their game stores.

hero.headline: Build Your Deck.
hero.subheadline: Battle Beacon helps Star Wars: Unlimited players find local events, track their competitive journey, and stay connected to their game stores. For stores, Beacon CRM fills events and keeps your player base engaged.

pain.sectionSubheading: Events go unannounced, results go untracked, and stores struggle to reach the players who are ready to play.

items.title: Events Are Hard to Find
items.description: Pre-releases, league nights, and store championships are scattered across Discord servers and store websites that players forget to monitor.

items.title: No Competitive Record
items.description: Match wins, tournament finishes, and deck performance have no permanent home. Your competitive history disappears after every event.

items.title: Stores Miss Signups
items.description: Game stores struggle to fill event seats without a reliable way to reach their player base and promote upcoming organised play.

items.title: Scattered Communities
items.description: Finding players for casual games, testing sessions, and weekly events across formats takes more effort than it should.

solution.sectionSubheading: Everything players and stores need to connect, compete, and grow.

items.title: Find Events Near You
items.description: See pre-releases, league nights, and store championships at local stores in one place so you never miss a spot.

items.title: Track Your Journey
items.description: Log results, build a player profile, earn badges, and track your competitive record across every tournament and format.

items.title: Store Operations & CRM
items.description: Beacon CRM gives game stores one place to manage events, seatings, player communications, and marketing automation.

cta.heading: Join Before Launch
cta.subheading: Sign up early to claim your exclusive early adopter badge and be first to know when Battle Beacon goes live in your local game store.
